_comment: Office PC Shop catalogue (equipment & consumables). Parts are added automatically from parts.json. kind: item = physical item delivered in a parcel; consumable = stock count; station = placeable equipment (M4 building mode).

items.name: DiagnostiKit Pro USB (test licence)
items.desc: Boots a unit into full hardware diagnostics. One unit at a time.

items.name: PaneOS Deploy USB (wipe + image)
items.desc: Certified 3-pass wipe and a fresh PaneOS install.

items.name: Hand pallet truck (2.5 t)
items.desc: Push it, jack a pallet up and move a whole delivery at once. Left by the door, no box.

items.name: Electric forklift (1.5 t, 4 m lift)
items.desc: Ex-hire counterbalance truck. E to get in, W/S drive, A/D steer, R/F (or scroll) raise and lower the forks. Reaches every level of pallet racking. Driven to your door.

items.name: Empty EUR pallet
items.desc: Stack laptops or servers on it and move them in one go with a pallet truck.

items.name: Laptop shipping boxes + foam (×10)
items.desc: Double-wall boxes with foam end caps.

items.name: Large server/tower boxes + foam (x5)
items.desc: Triple-wall cartons with corner blocks for towers and rack servers.

items.name: Packing tape (×6 rolls)
items.desc: Each roll seals about ten boxes.

items.name: Night shift licence
items.desc: Council licence, insurance and yard floodlights for working late. At 17:00 the host can keep going until 20:00, 22:00 or right through to 06:00. Staff get time-and-a-half; the meter keeps running. One-off.
